Name: (AT) Asters Walls and Floors Megapack
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: A bunch of my existing wallpaper and flooring mods all bundled into one mod
Description:
A bunch of my existing wallpaper and flooring mods all bundled into one mod
I have a [kofi page](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart)  if you'd like to fuel me with coffee or would like to commission some art_Additional information:_
If you're already using [Asters Big Interior Mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10400) you don't need the main file because it's already included there, but you might want the optional files
Mods shown in the screenshot include my [bathroom furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10982)  and my [Krobus House Cosplay](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11043/).
Inspired by [Floor Coverings](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11956?tab=files&file_id=54211), because I wanted to make an expansion pack for that but it'd be hard to find if I put it under the Big Interior Mod , you can find the expansion pack under optional files.
I have a video on how to use the AT framework in-game at the end of this [mod page](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9984) .

_Art Credits_

*   Narianka kindly gave me permission to recolor several of her [Pastel Rainbow Wallpapers](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11896)
